title: Where to reach this app
description: The best address to open first, then other ways in.

allow.title: Allow network access?
allow.description: The port is published on every interface and opened in the host firewall, so other devices can reach this app over plain HTTP.
allow.plain_http: Plain HTTP: traffic is not encrypted and sign-in gates configured on the domain do not apply on this port.
allow.recreates: The container is recreated with the new settings.

errors.load: Could not load the app addresses.

empty: No addresses yet. Deploy the app to get one.

traffic.hint: No traffic yet. Charts appear when the first request arrives.

hero.title: Open your app
hero.stopped: The app is not running, so this address will not answer until it starts.

advanced.title: Advanced: addresses for other apps and this server
advanced.hint: Only needed when wiring apps together or working on the server itself.
advanced.noPublic: This server has no public address, so the private network address is the way in.
advanced.autoDown: The free test address did not answer from this server. It needs public DNS and open ports 80 and 443, so the address above is the one to use.

note.container: The port the app listens on inside its container.
note.host: The port published on this server for the container port.
note.hostStopped: The app is not running, so no host port is published.
note.hostNone: No host port is published yet. Redeploy to publish one.
note.local: Works only when you are logged in on this server.
note.localNone: Available once the app is running.
note.private: Works only from the same network or over a VPN.
note.privateLocalhost: Not reachable from the network: the port is bound to localhost.
note.privateRemote: This app runs on another node. Open that node to see its network addresses.
note.public: Plain HTTP, anyone who knows the address can reach it.
note.domain: Served through the proxy with TLS.
note.domainAuto: Automatic address. Add your own domain for a trusted certificate.
note.internal: Other apps on this server connect with this name and port, for example http://{{address}}.

test.failed: The app did not answer on this address. It may still be starting.

reason.default: The app did not answer on this address. It may still be starting.
reason.container_not_running: The app is not running right now.
reason.container_not_listening: The app did not answer on this address. It may still be starting.
reason.firewall_closed: This address is blocked, most likely by a firewall on the server or the hosting provider.
reason.unreachable_from_host: The proxy is not answering on this address yet.
reason.tls_not_issued: The certificate is not trusted yet, so browsers will show a warning.
reason.proxy_route_missing: The proxy has no route for this address yet.
reason.upstream_failing: The proxy reached the server but the app behind it is not responding.
reason.app_error: The app answered with an error.
